run_batch_converter_cli: run the batch converter CLI to convert GLB FBX and BVH files to NPZ motion data
run_batch_converter_programmatic: run the BatchConverter class to batch convert animation files in a directory to NPZ format
convert_bvh_with_skeleton: convert BVH files using a specific skeleton preset like Cranberry Geno or Quadruped
find_supported_files: find all GLB FBX and BVH files recursively in the input directory
process_single_file: process a single animation file and convert it to NPZ motion data format
